about.what: The targeted collector's configuration for the continuous loop (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md sections 3.1, 3.2, 7). A governance file (section 6.5): written by a person or a deploy, never by the running platform.
about.built: 2026-09-28, group D build of the continuous loop

targets.why: the target classes, their taxa, the reject class id and the taxonomy authority are the funnel domain's (a pointer by path and sha256, never a copy; section 3.1)

class_space.why: numeric, unresolvable and no-name classes (and any class the status map does not map) get id 13, which exists only in intake labels; their boxes are kept so that per-box admission masks them (section 3.2)

alias_table.why: the project's species aliases (the v3.60.0 join); a name it joins has the funnel's 'target' status

query_grammar.why: section 7.1: binomial, common names, '<common> weed', '<common> detection', '<genus> dataset'; class-name search on the provider that declares class lists; the binomial on the annotation index; EPPO codes where a repository names classes by code

roboflow.why: the only provider that declares class lists before download (section 7.3); read only, never uploaded to

placement.why: GitHub is lab only: the login-node SOCKS proxy is refused from compute nodes (section 7.2); every other provider runs on the cluster once the network probe passes there

download.why: a timeout scaled to size (not a flat 480 s): 120 s plus the size at 2 MB/s

licence_policy.why: P6 (section 2.5): unresolved -> held; non-commercial (and no-derivatives) -> research_only; a permissive copy is preferred; nothing is redistributed

kg_yuzhenlu__cottonweeddet3.reason: Licence unresolved at harvest. The owner accepts this source for research use only (P6): every row and every model trained on it is research_only, and it is not for deployment or redistribution.

mediatum_1717366.reason: Licence unresolved at harvest. The owner accepts this source for research use only (P6): every row and every model trained on it is research_only, and it is not for deployment or redistribution.

budgets.why: section 6.6 limits (50 GB per source unless a person approves, 50 GB a day, the 200 GB proposal); a fetch keeps 20 GB free on its filesystem (the /ocean project quota itself is read by the autopilot, D27); floor_gb and floor_su are set by a person from the first wave (section 7.4)

estimates.why: ranking priors only (expected target boxes per GB, D20): 2 boxes per image, a text-only source counts half its boxes as targets

presumed_derivative.why: section 7.2 [review]: these two species have no known public source outside the lab of dev and test

never_fetch.why: 3SeasonWeedDet10: data2022 and data2023 are base v2 (D-A), data2021 holds copies of the evaluation photographs (KT3)

prefilter.why: section 7.2: whole-token rejects; the legacy-label copy rule of verify.old_join; the reference and exam datasets are never fetched, and neither is 3SeasonWeedDet10 under any record or title (its 2022/2023 parts are base v2, its 2021 part holds copies of the evaluation photographs)

class_map.why: section 3.2: target and target_synonym -> the target id; any other resolved plant -> the reject class; a relative of a target resolved above species rank (a target's genus), vernacular or by token only, and numeric, no-name, generic, state, non-object and unresolvable names -> unmapped

LuLab.why: the lab that produced dev and test, recognised by its Kaggle account, its dataset names and its author (P9: held until the copy scan)

NDSU.why: the lab of the ImageWeeds exam (same-lab sources are reported as such)

copy_scan.why: P9: an evaluation-lab source is fetched once one of these holds a passed calibration of the embedding copy detector (read through inc2.guard.load_calibration): the funnel's, the stream's own (group A writes it under splits/v2/leak/), or one under intake/leak/

weedai_5c78d067-8750-4803-9cbe-57df8fae5.table_source: the annotation index's upload record of PAGS8 (api/upload_info, category_statistics), read 2026-09-28: eight growth-stage categories of one species
weedai_5c78d067-8750-4803-9cbe-57df8fae5.pinned_by: group D build 2026-09-28, pending the owner's acceptance (section 10, item 5)

known_items_why: section 7.3: an audit of discovery recall (S1b), not a seed list; each stays fetchable after a recorded miss
